title: Capitals of the South Atlantic
short: Match each South Atlantic state with its capital, such as Tallahassee for Florida and Raleigh for North Carolina.
trouble: Students pick Miami for Florida or Charlotte for North Carolina; the capitals are Tallahassee and Raleigh.

blocks.html: Here are the capitals of the South Atlantic states.

The South Atlantic capitals: Dover (Delaware), Annapolis (Maryland), Richmond (Virginia), Charleston (West Virginia), Raleigh (North Carolina), Columbia (South Carolina), Atlanta (Georgia) and Tallahassee (Florida).

blocks.name: gg-map
blocks.cap: Each star is a state capital.

blocks.html: A capital is the city where a state's government meets: the governor works there and the legislature writes laws there. Many capitals were chosen long ago because they were near the middle of the state, easy for lawmakers to reach by horse or riverboat. The biggest cities often grew later, around ports and railroads. That is why the capital is so often not the biggest city.

blocks.title: Florida's capital
blocks.q: What is the capital of Florida?
steps: Miami, Orlando and Tampa are famous, and Jacksonville is the largest city.
The capital is in the Panhandle, the strip along the north.

blocks.html: Students pick Miami for Florida or Charlotte for North Carolina; the capitals are Tallahassee and Raleigh. Watch the two Charlestons: Charleston, West Virginia, is a capital, and Charleston, South Carolina, is a famous port city that is not.
Memory help. Raleigh and Richmond both start with R and sit next door: Richmond is Virginia's, Raleigh is North Carolina's. Annapolis, Maryland, is home to the U.S. Naval Academy.
